gates.notes: Requires final service name/domain decision and proof that production, staging, and development deployments are isolated.
Requires CI proof that full monorepo typecheck and test suite passed without timeout or hidden failures.
Requires production-like SMS and WhatsApp OTP delivery proof.
Requires proof that verified phone OTP creates or links a real authenticated session.
Requires browser E2E for email/password, OAuth, email OTP, phone OTP, passkey, MFA, logout, session refresh, hosted UI callback, and customer-app return.
Requires GitHub and Google callback URI/origin proof against real providers.
Requires SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning proof against real IdPs or an explicit beta/disabled launch decision.
Requires target production KMS/HSM integration evidence for signing, vault, refresh token, and offline POS snapshot key custody.
Requires proof that target production environment variables are present, environment-scoped, and not printed in logs.
Requires monitoring, alerting, status reporting, and incident response process verification.
Requires focused internal or external security review signoff before real customer launch.
